catalogue_entry.distinctive_facial_intent: Both brows rise high; eyes open fully; jaw drops into a broad rounded open mouth.
catalogue_entry.art_scope: Facial close-up performance reference paired with separately authored reusable full-body gesture references.

key_pose_sequence.visual_direction: Approved neutral face; fixed camera, scale and eye line.
Small preparatory change toward the authored intent; do not alter identity.
First clearly readable brow, eyelid and mouth changes.
Develop the specified facial relationships without jumping to peak.
Both brows rise high; eyes open fully; jaw drops into a broad rounded open mouth.
Sustain the recognizable peak with a small coherent follow-through; no new expression.
Release mouth, eyelid and brow tension in a readable coordinated transition.
Near-neutral face with only residual expression.
Match the approved neutral baseline and first panel.

timing.easing_intent: Ease into and out of expression; preserve sharper onset only where the intent calls for a startle or outburst.
timing.loop_note: No repeated cycle; complete release and neutral return.
timing.exit_behavior: Release current control state smoothly toward approved neutral; interruption blend is a later rig test.

facial_control_mapping.left_right_convention: Character left and right, not viewer left and right.
facial_control_mapping.intent: Both brows rise high; eyes open fully; jaw drops into a broad rounded open mouth.

overlays.rule: Keep effects separate from base facial anatomy; do not bake sheet graphics, captions or chibi cutaways into avatar textures.

references.intent: She reacts with raised brows and small backward step, hands lift slightly in surprise, then steps back to original stance.
She raises both open hands beside shoulders in startled reaction, eyes wide, then lowers them.

body_gesture.description: Suggested reusable full-body accompaniment selected by expression intent. These are separate visual references, not a bespoke combined face/body animation or validated rig. Animator must resolve staging, timing and anatomy on the actual model.
body_gesture.head_motion: Facial sheet and body performance remain separate; combine deliberately in the rig.

procedural_interactions.blink: Preserve normal blinking unless the authored pose explicitly closes an eye; resolve conflicts on actual rig.
procedural_interactions.gaze: Use fixed reference gaze except intentional side-eye, upward/downward gaze or specified eye movement.
procedural_interactions.lip_sync: Do not assume compatibility at extreme mouth poses; blend or override behavior remains to be tested.

observations: Inspected 1254x1254 nine-panel sheet. Neutral first panels; bilateral whole brow rise and round opening build through panel 4, peak panel 5, soften panel 6, release panels 7-9. Current rig cannot reproduce jaw/chin silhouette or full eye expansion. New timing is authored, not reference animation.

comparison.EXP-064: Fast inner-brow rotation with fixed outer anchors, .9 mouth and .7 purse, .66 peak. This candidate uses whole-brow vertical travel, .95 mouth and .32 purse, 1.35 peak and sustained broad opening. Shared open-surprise vocabulary means distinctness remains visual-review pending.
comparison.EXP-004: Round discovery becomes spread smile; this candidate has zero smile and spread throughout.

approval: Accepted reference art does not approve the candidate
